q: What's your situation at the new place?
why: Decides insurance and property tax tasks.
Renters need their deposit back. Owners need a plan for the home.

q: What's happening to the home you own?
why: Selling, renting out, and leaving it empty each need different insurance and tax steps.

q: How are you moving your things?
why: Interstate movers must be registered with the federal government, so it's worth checking.
opts: Renting a truck or moving container
Just suitcases or a few boxes

q: Which of these do you have?
why: Each one needs to be titled and registered in your new state.

q: How do you make a living?
why: Payroll, freelance income, and businesses each have their own address and tax updates.
Some employers can't pay people in every state, so HR needs to know early.
opts: Same job, working remotely from the new state

why: Medicaid and Marketplace plans are state-based, so they don't move with you.
opts: The Marketplace (HealthCare.gov or a state site)

q: Do you get any of these benefits?
why: Federal benefits follow you once your address is updated. State benefits usually have to be canceled and applied for again.
Kids need school and childcare plans. Pets need records and local licenses.
Refills need to move to a pharmacy near your new home.

q: Do you hold a state professional license?
why: Nursing, teaching, law, real estate, cosmetology and similar licenses are issued by states and may need to be transferred.

q: Are you in the military or a veteran?
why: Service members have special rules for tax residency and car registration.
opts: Active duty, or a military spouse

q: Are you in college or starting soon?
why: In-state tuition usually requires living in the state for a while first.
Rules for transporting and owning firearms differ by state.

q: Do you have a will, trust, or power of attorney?
why: State law governs these documents, so they're worth a quick review after a move.

q: Are you registered to vote where you live now?
why: You'll register in your new state and make sure the old registration is canceled.
